challenge.method: Checked which entity is the language and which entity is the implementer in the Preface. Compared Appendix A, printed p. 729, with Appendix I, printed p. 787 and physical p. 815, to challenge dialect, language equivalence, and full standards conformance readings.
challenge.results: IBM describes its implementation of COBOL and distinguishes IBM-specific extensions. Appendix I discusses particular 2002 and 2014 Standard features and provides no complete conformance finding. The identity evidence supports one directed implemented-by link, with general COBOL, IBM's product, and the IBM extensions in their distinct roles.

limitations: This direction links the independent COBOL language to one publisher-documented implementation. It conveys no claim of conformance to any exact COBOL standard edition, completeness, current support, or identical semantics.
